    * @notice Remove a supported token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removeSupportedToken(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Check no active deposits\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited > 0) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].isSupported = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from list\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokenList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokenList[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokenList[i] = supportedTokenList[\r\n                    supportedTokenList.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokenList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit TokenRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update token configuration\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount New max deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty New liquidation penalty\r\n     */\r\n    function updateTokenConfig(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].maxDepositAmount = maxDepositAmount;\r\n        supportedTokens[token].liquidationPenalty = liquidationPenalty;\r\n\r\n        emit TokenConfigUpdated(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Deposit collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param tokenAddress The address of the collateral token\r\n     * @param amount The amount to deposit\r\n     * @return depositId The ID of the created deposit\r\n     */\r\n    function depositCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 depositId) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[tokenAddress].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        TokenInfo storage tokenInfo = supportedTokens[tokenAddress];\r\n\r\n        // Check max deposit\r\n        if (amount > tokenInfo.maxDepositAmount) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        depositId = nextDepositId++;\r\n\r\n        deposits[depositId] = CollateralDeposit({\r\n            depositId: depositId,\r\n            depositor: msg.sender,\r\n            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,\r\n            amount: amount,\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            isLocked: false,\r\n            depositTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            lockedTimestamp: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        loanToDepositIds[loanId].push(depositId);\r\n        userDepositIds[msg.sender].push(depositId);\r\n\r\n        tokenInfo.totalDeposited += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens from user to this contract\r\n        IERC20(tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            address(this),\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralDeposited(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            tokenAddress,\r\n            amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return depositId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Withdraw unlocked collateral\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to withdraw\r\n     */\r\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 depositId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.depositor != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n\r\n        address token = deposit.tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount = deposit.amount;\r\n        address depositor = deposit.depositor;\r\n\r\n        // Update state\r\n        supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited -= amount;\r\n        delete deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens back to user\r\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(depositor, amount);\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(depositId, depositor, token, amount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Lock collateral when loan becomes active (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to lock\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function lockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n        if (deposit.loanId != loanId) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = true;\r\n        deposit.lockedTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralLocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Unlock collateral after successful repayment (called by LendingPool)\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit to unlock\r\n     */\r\n    function unlockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (!deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralUnlocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            deposit.loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate collateral for a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The outstanding loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param lender The address of the lender to receive funds\r\n     * @return recoveredAmount The amount recovered from liquidation in USD\r\n     */\r\n    function liquidateCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        address lender\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE)\r\n        nonReentrant\r\n        returns (uint256 recoveredAmount)\r\n    {\r\n        if (lender == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        if (depositIds.length == 0)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n        uint256 totalRecovered = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (!deposit.isLocked) continue;\r\n\r\n            // Check grace period\r\n            if (\r\n                block.timestamp <\r\n                deposit.lockedTimestamp + LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get collateral value\r\n            uint256 collateralValue = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Apply liquidation penalty\r\n            uint256 penalty = supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                .liquidationPenalty;\r\n            uint256 valueAfterPenalty = (collateralValue *\r\n                (BASIS_POINTS - penalty)) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n\r\n            totalRecovered += valueAfterPenalty;\r\n\r\n            // Transfer collateral to lender\r\n            IERC20(deposit.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(lender, deposit.amount);\r\n\r\n            // Update state\r\n            supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress].totalDeposited -= deposit\r\n                .amount;\r\n\r\n            emit CollateralLiquidated(\r\n                depositIds[i],\r\n                loanId,\r\n                deposit.depositor,\r\n                lender,\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                valueAfterPenalty\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Clear deposit\r\n            delete deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Clear loan deposits\r\n        delete loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n\r\n        return totalRecovered;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the USD value of collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return valueInUSD The total collateral value in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCollateralValue(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        uint256 totalValue = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit memory deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (deposit.amount > 0) {\r\n                uint256 value = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                    deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                    deposit.amount,\r\n                    tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                );\r\n                totalValue += value;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return totalValue;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get collateral deposit details\r\n     * @param depositId The ID of the deposit\r\n     * @return deposit The collateral deposit struct\r\n     */\r\n    function getCollateralDeposit(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit memory) {\r\n        return deposits[depositId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all collateral deposits for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return loanDeposits Array of collateral deposits\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory loanDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            loanDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return loanDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all deposits for a user\r\n     * @param user The user address\r\n     * @return userDeposits Array of user's deposits\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserDeposits(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = userDepositIds[user];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory userDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            userDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return userDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if collateral is sufficient for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param requiredRatio The required collateral ratio (basis points)\r\n     * @return isSufficient True if collateral is sufficient\r\n     */\r\n    function isCollateralSufficient(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        uint256 requiredRatio\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return true;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        uint256 actualRatio = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return actualRatio >= requiredRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate health factor for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @return healthFactor The health factor (10000 = 100%)\r\n     */\r\n    function calculateHealthFactor(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 healthFactor) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return type(uint256).max;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        healthFactor = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return healthFactor;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a loan is eligible for liquidation\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param loanAmount The loan amount in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     * @return canLiquidate True if loan can be liquidated\r\n     */\r\n    function canLiquidate(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return false;\r\n\r\n        uint256 healthFactor = this.calculateHealthFactor(loanId, loanAmount);\r\n\r\n        // Can liquidate if health factor below threshold (110%)\r\n        return healthFactor < LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all supported collateral tokens\r\n     * @return tokens Array of supported token addresses\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokenList;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get token information\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return tokenInfo The token info struct\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenInfo(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (TokenInfo memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens[token];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed collateral value information\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param amount The token amount\r\n     * @return collateralValue Struct with value details\r\n     */\r\n    function getCollateralValueDetails(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralValue memory) {\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n            token,\r\n            amount,\r\n            tokenDecimals[token]\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return\r\n            CollateralValue({\r\n                tokenAddress: token,\r\n                amount: amount,\r\n                valueInUSD: valueInUSD,\r\n                lastUpdated: block.timestamp\r\n            });\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xab99fbb0548117617b48c5e270ae9e97968940342d5fba3c9a16cb97b0b8dacc","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LendingPool.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ReputationManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./CollateralManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./LoanLogic.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ActiveOfferLib.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title LendingPool\r\n * @notice Core P2P lending pool with reputation-based matching\r\n * @dev Integrates with ReputationManager and CollateralManager\r\n */\r\ncontract LendingPool is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    CollateralManager public immutable collateralManager;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextOfferId = 1;\r\n    uint256 public nextLoanId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => LoanOffer) public loanOffers;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => Loan) public loans;\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userOffers;\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userLoans;\r\n\r\n    // Active offers lists\r\n    uint256[] public activeLenderOffers;\r\n    uint256[] public activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n\r\n    // Platform fee (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public platformFeeRate = 100; // 1%\r\n    uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PLATFORM_FEE = 500; // 5% max\r\n\r\n    // Loan constraints\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_LOAN_DURATION = 1 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_LOAN_DURATION = 365 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_INTEREST_RATE = 5000; // 50%\r\n\r\n    address public feeCollector;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Enums ============\r\n\r\n    enum LoanStatus {\r\n        PENDING,\r\n        ACTIVE,\r\n        REPAID,\r\n        DEFAULTED,\r\n        CANCELLED\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    enum LoanType {\r\n        LENDER_OFFER,\r\n        BORROW_REQUEST\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct LoanTerms {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 principalAmount;\r\n        uint256 collateralAmount;\r\n        address collateralToken;\r\n        uint256 interestRate;\r\n        uint256 duration;\r\n        uint256 minReputation;\r\n        uint256 collateralRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct LoanOffer {\r\n        uint256 offerId;\r\n        LoanType offerType;\r\n        address creator;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct Loan {\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        LoanType loanType;\r\n        address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        LoanStatus status;\r\n        uint256 startTime;\r\n        uint256 dueTime;\r\n        uint256 amountRepaid;\r\n        uint256 collateralDepositId;\r\n        bool hasCoSigner;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event LoanOfferCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed offerId,\r\n        address indexed creator,\r\n        LoanType offerType,\r\n        uint256 principalAmount,\r\n        uint256 interestRate,\r\n        uint256 duration\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanOfferCancelled(uint256 indexed offerId, address indexed creator);\r\n\r\n    event LoanMatched(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        uint256 indexed offerId,\r\n        address indexed lender,\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 principalAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanRepayment(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanRepaid(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 totalRepaid\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanDefaulted(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 unpaidAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PlatformFeeCollected(uint256 indexed loanId, uint256 feeAmount);\r\n\r\n    event PlatformFeeRateUpdated(uint256 oldRate, uint256 newRate);\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n    error LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n    error LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotOverdue();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error LendingPool__TransferFailed();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidFeeRate();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(\r\n        address _reputationManager,\r\n        address _collateralManager,\r\n        address _feeCollector\r\n    ) {\r\n        if (\r\n            _reputationManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _collateralManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _feeCollector == address(0)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        collateralManager = CollateralManager(_collateralManager);\r\n        feeCollector = _feeCollector;\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Offer Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Create a new loan offer or borrow request\r\n     * @param offerType Type of offer (LENDER_OFFER or BORROW_REQUEST)\r\n     * @param terms The loan terms\r\n     * @return offerId The ID of the created offer\r\n     */\r\n    function createLoanOffer(\r\n        LoanType offerType,\r\n        LoanTerms calldata terms\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 offerId) {\r\n        // Validate terms\r\n        _validateLoanTerms(terms);\r\n\r\n        offerId = nextOfferId++;\r\n\r\n        loanOffers[offerId] = LoanOffer({\r\n            offerId: offerId,\r\n            offerType: offerType,\r\n            creator: msg.sender,\r\n            terms: terms,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userOffers[msg.sender].push(offerId);\r\n\r\n        // Add to appropriate active list\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            activeLenderOffers.push(offerId);\r\n\r\n            // Lender must lock funds\r\n            IERC20(terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            activeBorrowerRequests.push(offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCreated(\r\n            offerId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            offerType,\r\n            terms.principalAmount,\r\n            terms.interestRate,\r\n            terms.duration\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return offerId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Cancel an active loan offer\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer to cancel\r\n     */\r\n    function cancelLoanOffer(uint256 offerId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n        if (offer.creator != msg.sender)\r\n            revert LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from active lists\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Return funds if lender offer\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCancelled(offerId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Accept a loan offer and create an active loan\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer to accept\r\n     * @param collateralDepositId The ID of the collateral deposit (for borrowers)\r\n     * @return loanId The ID of the created loan\r\n     */\r\n    function acceptLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        uint256 collateralDepositId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 loanId) {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n\r\n        address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            // Lender created offer, msg.sender is borrower\r\n            lender = offer.creator;\r\n            borrower = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n            // Check borrower's reputation\r\n            if (\r\n                !reputationManager.meetsReputationRequirement(\r\n                    borrower,\r\n                    offer.terms.minReputation\r\n                )\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n            }\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Borrower created request, msg.sender is lender\r\n            lender = msg.sender;\r\n            borrower = offer.creator;\r\n\r\n            // Lender must provide funds\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                lender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Verify and lock collateral\r\n        if (offer.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            bool sufficient = collateralManager.isCollateralSufficient(\r\n                collateralDepositId,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount,\r\n                offer.terms.collateralRatio\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            if (!sufficient) revert LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n            collateralManager.lockCollateral(collateralDepositId, nextLoanId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Create loan\r\n        loanId = nextLoanId++;\r\n\r\n        loans[loanId] = Loan({\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            loanType: offer.offerType,\r\n            lender: lender,\r\n            borrower: borrower,\r\n            terms: offer.terms,\r\n            status: LoanStatus.ACTIVE,\r\n            startTime: block.timestamp,\r\n            dueTime: block.timestamp + offer.terms.duration,\r\n            amountRepaid: 0,\r\n            collateralDepositId: collateralDepositId,\r\n            hasCoSigner: false,\r\n            coSigner: address(0)\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userLoans[lender].push(loanId);\r\n        userLoans[borrower].push(loanId);\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate offer\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Transfer principal to borrower (minus platform fee)\r\n        uint256 platformFee = (offer.terms.principalAmount * platformFeeRate) /\r\n            BASIS_POINTS;\r\n        uint256 amountToBorrower = offer.terms.principalAmount - platformFee;\r\n\r\n        IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            amountToBorrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (platformFee > 0) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                feeCollector,\r\n                platformFee\r\n            );\r\n            emit PlatformFeeCollected(loanId, platformFee);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanMatched(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            offerId,\r\n            lender,\r\n            borrower,\r\n            offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return loanId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Loan Management ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Repay an active loan (partial or full)\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param amount The amount to repay\r\n     */\r\n    function repayLoan(uint256 loanId, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        if (amount > remainingAmount) {\r\n            amount = remainingAmount;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.amountRepaid += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer repayment from borrower to lender\r\n        IERC20(loan.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loan.lender,\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepayment(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            amount,\r\n            remainingAmount - amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Check if fully repaid\r\n        if (loan.amountRepaid >= amountDue) {\r\n            _completeLoanRepayment(loanId);\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Liquidate a defaulted loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function liquidateLoan(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n        if (block.timestamp <= loan.dueTime)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotOverdue();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 unpaidAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        // Liquidate collateral\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount = 0;\r\n        if (loan.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            recoveredAmount = collateralManager.liquidateCollateral(\r\n                loanId,\r\n                unpaidAmount,\r\n                loan.lender\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.DEFAULTED;\r\n\r\n        // Apply reputation penalties\r\n        reputationManager.recordDefault(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Penalize co-signer if exists\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner) {\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                loan.coSigner,\r\n                loan.borrower,\r\n                loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanDefaulted(loanId, loan.borrower, unpaidAmount);\r\n        emit CollateralLiquidated(loanId, loan.borrower, recoveredAmount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate total amount due for a loan (principal + interest)\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return The total amount due\r\n     */\r\n    /*\r\n    function calculateAmountDue(uint256 loanId) public view returns (uint256) {\r\n        Loan memory loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (\r\n            loan.status == LoanStatus.PENDING ||\r\n            loan.status == LoanStatus.CANCELLED\r\n        ) {\r\n            return 0;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 interest = (loan.terms.principalAmount *\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n        return loan.terms.principalAmount + interest;\r\n    }\r\n    */\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a loan is past due\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return true if loan is past due\r\n     */\r\n    function isLoanOverdue(uint256 loanId) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        Loan memory loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE) return false;\r\n\r\n        return block.timestamp > loan.dueTime;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get loan details\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @return Loan struct with all details\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoan(uint256 loanId) external view returns (Loan memory) {\r\n        return loans[loanId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get loan offer details\r\n     * @param offerId The ID of the offer\r\n     * @return LoanOffer struct with all details\r\n     */\r\n    function getLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId\r\n    ) external view returns (LoanOffer memory) {\r\n        return loanOffers[offerId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveLenderOfferIds()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (uint256[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        return activeLenderOffers;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveBorrowerRequestIds()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (uint256[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        return activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all loans for a user (as lender or borrower)\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return Array of loan IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserLoans(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userLoans[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get user's loan offers\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return Array of offer IDs\r\n     */\r\n    function getUserOffers(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userOffers[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the next loan ID (for counting total loans)\r\n     * @return The next loan ID\r\n     */\r\n    function getNextLoanId() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return nextLoanId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the next offer ID (for counting total offers)\r\n     * @return The next offer ID\r\n     */\r\n    function getNextOfferId() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return nextOfferId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the platform fee rate\r\n     * @return The platform fee rate in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function getPlatformFeeRate() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return platformFeeRate;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the basis points constant\r\n     * @return The basis points value (10000)\r\n     */\r\n    function getBasisPoints() external pure returns (uint256) {\r\n        return BASIS_POINTS;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Admin Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update platform fee rate\r\n     * @param newFeeRate New fee rate in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function setPlatformFeeRate(\r\n        uint256 newFeeRate\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeRate > MAX_PLATFORM_FEE) revert LendingPool__InvalidFeeRate();\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldRate = platformFeeRate;\r\n        platformFeeRate = newFeeRate;\r\n\r\n        emit PlatformFeeRateUpdated(oldRate, newFeeRate);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update fee collector address\r\n     * @param newFeeCollector New fee collector address\r\n     */\r\n    function setFeeCollector(\r\n        address newFeeCollector\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeCollector == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        feeCollector = newFeeCollector;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Complete loan repayment and unlock collateral\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     */\r\n    function _completeLoanRepayment(uint256 loanId) internal {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.REPAID;\r\n\r\n        // Unlock collateral\r\n        if (loan.terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n            collateralManager.unlockCollateral(loan.collateralDepositId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Update reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Reward co-signer if exists\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(loan.coSigner, loan.borrower);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepaid(loanId, loan.borrower, loan.amountRepaid);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Validate loan terms\r\n     * @param terms The loan terms to validate\r\n     */\r\n    function _validateLoanTerms(LoanTerms calldata terms) internal pure {\r\n        if (terms.principalAmount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n        if (\r\n            terms.duration < MIN_LOAN_DURATION ||\r\n            terms.duration > MAX_LOAN_DURATION\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n        }\r\n        if (terms.interestRate > MAX_INTEREST_RATE) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n        }\r\n        if (terms.collateralRatio > 0 && terms.collateralRatio < 10000) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove offer from active list\r\n     * @param offerId The offer ID to remove\r\n     * @param offerType The type of offer\r\n     */\r\n    function _removeFromActiveList(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        LoanType offerType\r\n    ) internal {\r\n        uint256[] storage activeList = offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER\r\n            ? activeLenderOffers\r\n            : activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < activeList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (activeList[i] == offerId) {\r\n                activeList[i] = activeList[activeList.length - 1];\r\n                activeList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x4b7322856c6ace8e4cce1bddac596282734c011637e9a53d208a5a1cf7a2b650","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LoanLogic.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nlibrary LoanLogic {\r\n    uint256 internal constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n\r\n    function calculateAmountDue(\r\n        uint256 principal,\r\n        uint256 interestRate\r\n    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {\r\n        return principal + (principal * interestRate) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x010dcac8a75869a5dfdde424cc73ee767d346716728b4427912496c615e68677","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/PriceOracle.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/shared/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title PriceOracle\r\n * @notice Wrapper contract for Chainlink price feeds\r\n * @dev Provides unified interface for getting token prices in USD\r\n */\r\ncontract PriceOracle is Ownable {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    // Mapping from token address to Chainlink price feed\r\n    mapping(address => AggregatorV3Interface) public priceFeeds;\r\n\r\n    // Mapping to track supported tokens\r\n    mapping(address => bool) public isSupportedToken;\r\n\r\n    // Array of all supported tokens\r\n    address[] public supportedTokens;\r\n\r\n    // Stale price threshold (default: 1 hour)\r\n    uint256 public stalePriceThreshold = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // Price deviation threshold for additional validation (in basis points)\r\n    // e.g., 5000 = 50% deviation allowed\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PRICE_DEVIATION = 5000; // 50%\r\n\r\n    // Decimals for USD price (standardized to 18 decimals)\r\n    uint8 public constant PRICE_DECIMALS = 18;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct PriceData {\r\n        uint256 price; // Price in USD (18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 timestamp; // When price was updated\r\n        uint80 roundId; // Chainlink round ID\r\n        bool isValid; // Whether price is valid\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        address indexed priceFeed,\r\n        string tokenSymbol\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event PriceRetrieved(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 price,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event StalePriceThresholdUpdated(\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold,\r\n        uint256 newThreshold\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceValidationFailed(address indexed token, string reason);\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n    error PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n    error PriceOracle__StalePrice(uint256 timeSinceUpdate);\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenAlreadySupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n    error PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() Ownable() {}\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Set or update price feed for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param priceFeed The Chainlink price feed address\r\n     * @param tokenSymbol The token symbol (for events)\r\n     */\r\n    function setPriceFeed(\r\n        address token,\r\n        address priceFeed,\r\n        string calldata tokenSymbol\r\n    ) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (priceFeed == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n\r\n        // Validate price feed by attempting to get latest round data\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface feed = AggregatorV3Interface(priceFeed);\r\n        try feed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            if (answer <= 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Add to supported tokens if new\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) {\r\n            supportedTokens.push(token);\r\n            isSupportedToken[token] = true;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        priceFeeds[token] = feed;\r\n        emit PriceFeedUpdated(token, priceFeed, tokenSymbol);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a price feed for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removePriceFeed(address token) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        delete priceFeeds[token];\r\n        isSupportedToken[token] = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from supported tokens array\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokens.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokens[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokens[i] = supportedTokens[\r\n                    supportedTokens.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokens.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit PriceFeedRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the latest price for a token in USD\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return price The price in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getPrice(address token) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        PriceData memory priceData = _getPriceData(token);\r\n\r\n        if (!priceData.isValid) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return priceData.price;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed price data for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return priceData Struct containing price, timestamp, and validity\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (PriceData memory) {\r\n        return _getPriceData(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get token value in USD\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param amount The token amount (in token's native decimals)\r\n     * @param tokenDecimals The token's decimal places\r\n     * @return valueInUSD The value in USD (18 decimals)\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        // Normalize token amount to 18 decimals, then multiply by price\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount * (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        } else {\r\n            // If token has > 18 decimals (rare), scale down\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount / (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return valueInUSD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get USD amount required for specific token amount\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param usdAmount The USD amount desired (18 decimals)\r\n     * @param tokenDecimals The token's decimal places\r\n     * @return tokenAmount The token amount needed\r\n     */\r\n    function getTokenAmountForUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 usdAmount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 tokenAmount) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        if (price == 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n\r\n        // Calculate token amount needed (in 18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 tokenAmount18Decimals = (usdAmount * 1e18) / price;\r\n\r\n        // Convert to token's native decimals\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals / (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n        } else {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals * (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return tokenAmount;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a price is stale\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return isStale True if price is stale\r\n     */\r\n    function isPriceStale(address token) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return true;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return block.timestamp - updatedAt > stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return true;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get all supported tokens\r\n     * @return Array of supported token addresses\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the number of supported tokens\r\n     * @return count The count of supported tokens\r\n     */\r\n    function getSupportedTokenCount() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return supportedTokens.length;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update stale price threshold\r\n     * @param newThreshold New threshold in seconds\r\n     */\r\n    function setStalePriceThreshold(uint256 newThreshold) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (newThreshold == 0 || newThreshold > 1 days) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold = stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        stalePriceThreshold = newThreshold;\r\n\r\n        emit StalePriceThresholdUpdated(oldThreshold, newThreshold);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get price feed decimals for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return decimals The decimals of the price feed\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceFeedDecimals(address token) external view returns (uint8) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.decimals();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get price feed description for a token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return description The description of the price feed\r\n     */\r\n    function getPriceFeedDescription(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (string memory) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.description();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Internal function to get price data with validation\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return priceData Struct containing price information\r\n     */\r\n    function _getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (PriceData memory priceData) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        if (address(priceFeed) == address(0))\r\n            revert PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80 roundId,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256 startedAt,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80 answeredInRound\r\n        ) {\r\n            // Validate round data\r\n            if (answeredInRound < roundId) {\r\n                priceData.isValid = false;\r\n                return priceData;\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for stale price\r\n            uint256 timeSinceUpdate = block.timestamp - updatedAt;\r\n            if (timeSinceUpdate > stalePriceThreshold) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__StalePrice(timeSinceUpdate);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for invalid price\r\n            if (answer <= 0) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get price feed decimals and normalize to 18 decimals\r\n            uint8 decimals = priceFeed.decimals();\r\n            uint256 price;\r\n\r\n            if (decimals < PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) * (10 ** (PRICE_DECIMALS - decimals));\r\n            } else if (decimals > PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) / (10 ** (decimals - PRICE_DECIMALS));\r\n            } else {\r\n                price = uint256(answer);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            priceData = PriceData({\r\n                price: price,\r\n                timestamp: updatedAt,\r\n                roundId: roundId,\r\n                isValid: true\r\n            });\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if price feed is responsive\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @return isResponsive True if price feed is working\r\n     */\r\n    function _isPriceFeedResponsive(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return false;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return answer > 0;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return false;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xc695bf2655a7dcd76f6d21fdd2ed54ae46eccfefb465c27974d0f15cce4538df","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/ReputationManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\n\r\n/**\r\n * @title ReputationManager\r\n * @notice Manages user reputation scores for decentralized lending platform\r\n * @dev Implements multi-factor reputation system with decay, anti-gaming, and co-signing\r\n */\r\ncontract ReputationManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant COSIGNING_ROLE = keccak256(\"COSIGNING_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant VERIFIER_ROLE = keccak256(\"VERIFIER_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant DATA_FEED_ROLE = keccak256(\"DATA_FEED_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    // Reputation score bounds\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_REPUTATION = 0;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION = 1000;\r\n    uint256 public constant STARTING_REPUTATION = 100;\r\n\r\n    // Reputation weights (out of 100 for percentage)\r\n    uint256 public constant REPAYMENT_WEIGHT = 50; // 50% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant TRANSACTION_WEIGHT = 25; // 25% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNING_WEIGHT = 15; // 15% weight\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_WEIGHT = 10; // 10% weight\r\n\r\n    // Decay parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_START_DAYS = 90; // Start decay after 90 days of inactivity\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_DECAY_PERCENTAGE = 50; // Max 50% reputation loss\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_PERIOD_DAYS = 180; // Full decay over 180 days\r\n\r\n    // Anti-gaming parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant REPUTATION_CAP_PERIOD = 1 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_CAP_DAYS = 365; // Wallet age contribution caps at 1 year\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGN_COOLDOWN = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGN_BONUS = 100;\r\n\r\n    // Off-chain verification bonuses\r\n    uint256 public constant EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 60;\r\n    uint256 public constant PHONE_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 140;\r\n\r\n    // Repayment scoring\r\n    uint256 public constant SUCCESSFUL_REPAYMENT_BASE = 20;\r\n    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_PENALTY_BASE = 100;\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNER_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER = 30; // 30% of borrower penalty\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct ReputationData {\r\n        uint256 baseScore;\r\n        uint256 totalTransactions;\r\n        uint256 uniqueCounterparties;\r\n        uint256 totalValueTransferred;\r\n        uint256 successfulRepayments;\r\n        uint256 totalRepaymentValue;\r\n        uint256 defaults;\r\n        uint256 totalDefaultValue;\r\n        uint256 walletCreationTime;\r\n        uint256 lastActivityTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lastReputationUpdate;\r\n        bool emailVerified;\r\n        bool phoneVerified;\r\n        uint256 coSigningBonus;\r\n        uint256 reputationGainedToday;\r\n        uint256 lastDailyResetTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningHistory {\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) coSignCount; // borrower => count\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) lastCoSignTime; // borrower => timestamp\r\n        uint256 totalActiveCoSigns;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Storage ============\r\n\r\n    mapping(address => ReputationData) private reputationData;\r\n    mapping(address => CoSigningHistory) private coSigningHistory;\r\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private hasInteracted; // For unique counterparties\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event ReputationUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 oldScore,\r\n        uint256 newScore,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OffChainVerification(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        string verificationType,\r\n        uint256 bonusAdded\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationDecay(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 decayAmount,\r\n        uint256 daysSinceActivity\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationPenalty(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OnChainMetricsUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 transactions,\r\n        uint256 counterparties,\r\n        uint256 totalValue\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error ReputationManager__Unauthorized();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n    error ReputationManager__ReputationCapReached();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() {\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(VERIFIER_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get the current reputation score for a user (with decay applied)\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return The calculated reputation score\r\n     */\r\n    function getReputationScore(address user) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get detailed reputation data for a user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return ReputationData struct with all metrics\r\n     */\r\n    function getReputationData(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (ReputationData memory) {\r\n        return reputationData[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Initialize reputation for a new user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     */\r\n    function initializeReputation(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE) {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n\r\n        // Only initialize if not already initialized\r\n        if (data.walletCreationTime == 0) {\r\n            data.baseScore = STARTING_REPUTATION;\r\n            data.walletCreationTime = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastReputationUpdate = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastDailyResetTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n            emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n                user,\r\n                0,\r\n                STARTING_REPUTATION,\r\n                \"Initial reputation\"\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Record successful loan repayment and update reputation\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     * @param loanAmount The amount repaid\r\n     */\r\n    function recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        // Update repayment history\r\n        data.successfulRepayments++;\r\n        data.totalRepaymentValue += loanAmount;\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        // Calculate reputation bonus based on loan amount\r\n        uint256 bonus = _calculateRepaymentBonus(loanAmount);\r\n\r\n        // Check daily cap\r\n        _checkAndResetDailyCap(borrower);\r\n        if (\r\n            data.reputationGainedToday + bonus > MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD\r\n        ) {\r\n            bonus = MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD - data.reputationGainedToday;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + bonus, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n        data.reputationGainedToday += bonus;\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Successful repayment\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Record loan default and apply penalty\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower who defaulted\r\n     * @param loanAmount The amount of the defaulted loan\r\n     */\r\n    function recordDefault(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        // Update default history\r\n        data.defaults++;\r\n        data.totalDefaultValue += loanAmount;\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        // Calculate penalty (severe)\r\n        uint256 penalty = _calculateDefaultPenalty(\r\n            loanAmount,\r\n            data.totalRepaymentValue\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Apply penalty\r\n        if (data.baseScore > penalty) {\r\n            data.baseScore -= penalty;\r\n        } else {\r\n            data.baseScore = MIN_REPUTATION;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n        emit ReputationPenalty(borrower, penalty, \"Loan default\");\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Default penalty applied\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Record off-chain verification (email/phone)\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @param verificationType \"email\" or \"phone\"\r\n     */\r\n    function recordOffChainVerification(\r\n        address user,\r\n        string calldata verificationType\r\n    ) external onlyRole(VERIFIER_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(user);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n        uint256 bonus = 0;\r\n\r\n        if (keccak256(bytes(verificationType)) == keccak256(bytes(\"email\"))) {\r\n            if (data.emailVerified) revert ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n            data.emailVerified = true;\r\n            bonus = EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BONUS;\r\n        } else if (\r\n            keccak256(bytes(verificationType)) == keccak256(bytes(\"phone\"))\r\n        ) {\r\n            if (data.phoneVerified) revert ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n            data.phoneVerified = true;\r\n            bonus = PHONE_VERIFICATION_BONUS;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (bonus > 0) {\r\n            data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + bonus, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n            uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n            emit OffChainVerification(user, verificationType, bonus);\r\n            emit ReputationUpdated(user, oldScore, newScore, verificationType);\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add co-signing bonus to borrower's reputation\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     * @param coSigner The address of the co-signer\r\n     * @param coSignerReputation The reputation of the co-signer\r\n     * @return The bonus amount added\r\n     */\r\n    function addCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) nonReentrant returns (uint256) {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0) || coSigner == address(0)) {\r\n            revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n        _ensureInitialized(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        // Calculate bonus with diminishing returns\r\n        uint256 bonus = _calculateCoSigningBonus(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            coSignerReputation\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (bonus > 0) {\r\n            ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n\r\n            // Check daily cap\r\n            _checkAndResetDailyCap(borrower);\r\n            if (\r\n                data.reputationGainedToday + bonus >\r\n                MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD\r\n            ) {\r\n                bonus =\r\n                    MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD -\r\n                    data.reputationGainedToday;\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            data.coSigningBonus = _min(\r\n                data.coSigningBonus + bonus,\r\n                MAX_COSIGN_BONUS\r\n            );\r\n            data.reputationGainedToday += bonus;\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n            // Update co-signing history\r\n            CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n            history.coSignCount[borrower]++;\r\n            history.lastCoSignTime[borrower] = block.timestamp;\r\n            history.totalActiveCoSigns++;\r\n\r\n            uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n            emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n                borrower,\r\n                oldScore,\r\n                newScore,\r\n                \"Co-signing bonus\"\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return bonus;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Apply penalty to co-signer when borrower defaults\r\n     * @param coSigner The address of the co-signer\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower who defaulted\r\n     * @param loanAmount The amount of the defaulted loan\r\n     */\r\n    function penalizeCoSigner(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (coSigner == address(0) || borrower == address(0)) {\r\n            revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[coSigner];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        // Calculate penalty (30% of what borrower would get)\r\n        uint256 borrowerPenalty = _calculateDefaultPenalty(loanAmount, 0);\r\n        uint256 coSignerPenalty = (borrowerPenalty *\r\n            COSIGNER_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER) / 100;\r\n\r\n        // Apply penalty\r\n        if (data.baseScore > coSignerPenalty) {\r\n            data.baseScore -= coSignerPenalty;\r\n        } else {\r\n            data.baseScore = MIN_REPUTATION;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Reduce co-signing bonus\r\n        if (data.coSigningBonus > coSignerPenalty / 2) {\r\n            data.coSigningBonus -= coSignerPenalty / 2;\r\n        } else {\r\n            data.coSigningBonus = 0;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        // Update co-signing history\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n        if (history.totalActiveCoSigns > 0) {\r\n            history.totalActiveCoSigns--;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n        emit ReputationPenalty(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            coSignerPenalty,\r\n            \"Co-signed loan defaulted\"\r\n        );\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Co-signer penalty\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Reward co-signer when borrower repays successfully\r\n     * @param coSigner The address of the co-signer\r\n     * @param borrower The address of the borrower\r\n     */\r\n    function rewardCoSigner(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (coSigner == address(0) || borrower == address(0)) {\r\n            revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[coSigner];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        // Small reward for successful co-signing\r\n        uint256 reward = 10;\r\n\r\n        // Check daily cap\r\n        _checkAndResetDailyCap(coSigner);\r\n        if (\r\n            data.reputationGainedToday + reward > MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD\r\n        ) {\r\n            reward =\r\n                MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD -\r\n                data.reputationGainedToday;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + reward, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n        data.reputationGainedToday += reward;\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        // Update co-signing history\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n        if (history.totalActiveCoSigns > 0) {\r\n            history.totalActiveCoSigns--;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Co-signing reward\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update on-chain transaction metrics for a user\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @param txCount Number of transactions\r\n     * @param counterparty Address interacted with\r\n     * @param txValue Value of transaction\r\n     */\r\n    function updateOnChainMetrics(\r\n        address user,\r\n        uint256 txCount,\r\n        address counterparty,\r\n        uint256 txValue\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE) {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(user);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n\r\n        // Update transaction count\r\n        data.totalTransactions += txCount;\r\n\r\n        // Update unique counterparties\r\n        if (counterparty != address(0) && !hasInteracted[user][counterparty]) {\r\n            hasInteracted[user][counterparty] = true;\r\n            data.uniqueCounterparties++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Update total value (small transactions contribute less)\r\n        if (txValue > 0.01 ether) {\r\n            // Minimum threshold\r\n            data.totalValueTransferred += txValue;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit OnChainMetricsUpdated(\r\n            user,\r\n            data.totalTransactions,\r\n            data.uniqueCounterparties,\r\n            data.totalValueTransferred\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if a user meets minimum reputation requirement\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @param minimumReputation The minimum reputation required\r\n     * @return true if user meets requirement\r\n     */\r\n    function meetsReputationRequirement(\r\n        address user,\r\n        uint256 minimumReputation\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return _calculateReputationScore(user) >= minimumReputation;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Get co-signing count for a pair\r\n     * @param coSigner The co-signer address\r\n     * @param borrower The borrower address\r\n     * @return The number of times co-signed\r\n     */\r\n    function getCoSignCount(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return coSigningHistory[coSigner].coSignCount[borrower];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Check if diminishing returns apply\r\n     * @param coSigner The co-signer address\r\n     * @param borrower The borrower address\r\n     * @return true if diminishing returns apply\r\n     */\r\n    function hasDiminishingReturns(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n\r\n        // Check if in cooldown period\r\n        if (\r\n            block.timestamp < history.lastCoSignTime[borrower] + COSIGN_COOLDOWN\r\n        ) {\r\n            return history.coSignCount[borrower] > 0;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return false;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Calculate total reputation score with all factors\r\n     * @param user The address of the user\r\n     * @return The final reputation score\r\n     */\r\n    function _calculateReputationScore(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) internal view returns (uint256) {\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n\r\n  address[] public supportedTokenList;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextDepositId;\r\n\r\n    // Liquidation parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 11000; // uint256 public constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000; // 100%\r\n\r\n    // Grace period before liquidation (to give borrower time to add collateral)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD = uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        bool isLocked;\r\n        uint256 depositTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lockedTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct TokenInfo {\r\n        bool uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(\r\n        uint256 indexed );\r\n\r\n    event TokenAdded(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event TokenConfigUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n    error CollateralManager__TransferFailed();\r\n    error CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _priceOracle) {\r\n        if (_priceOracle == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        priceOracle = PriceOracle(_priceOracle);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LIQUIDATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n\r\n        nextDepositId = 1;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Add a supported collateral token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param decimals_ The token decimals\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount Maximum deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty Liquidation penalty in basis points\r\n     */\r\n    function addSupportedToken(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint8 decimals_,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].isSupported)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n\r\n        // Verify token is supported by price oracle\r\n        if (!priceOracle.isSupportedToken(token)) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token] = });\r\n\r\n        tokenDecimals[token] = decimals_;\r\n        supportedTokenList.push(token);\r\n\r\n        emit TokenAdded(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Remove a supported token\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     */\r\n    function removeSupportedToken(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) (supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited > 0) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].isSupported = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from list\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokenList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokenList[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokenList[i] = supportedTokenList[\r\n TokenRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Update token configuration\r\n     * @param token The token address\r\n     * @param maxDepositAmount New max deposit amount\r\n     * @param liquidationPenalty New liquidation penalty\r\n     */\r\n    function updateTokenConfig(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].maxDepositAmount = maxDepositAmount;\r\n        supportedTokens[token].liquidationPenalty = liquidationPenalty;\r\n\r\n        emit TokenConfigUpdated(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    /**\r\n     * @notice Deposit collateral for a loan\r\n     * @param loanId The ID of the loan\r\n     * @param tokenAddress The address of the collateral
